messages:
miriam: CI red on midnight bench-smoke run — a bunch of tests failed in the smoke suite after the model refresh. logs: s3://bench-artifacts/1769999999/logs.tar.gz Anyone able to take a quick look? @sam @jordan
infra-bot: job bench-smoke (id: b-2026-1769999999) FAILED — exit=1. Started 2026-03-15T00:03Z. Artifacts uploaded: s3://bench-artifacts/1769999999/ (auto-notify)
sam: looking. quick question — are these new failures or a regression vs yesterday?
jordan: eyeballing the logs now, first glance shows timeouts in `test_embedding_cache_expiry` and `bench_end2end_controller:test_ping` (both timed out ~30s). Could be infra slowness or a flaky test.
dev-qa: fyi model-refresh cron ran at 00:00 and rolled staging -> model:v2.2.0 (was v2.1.2). tagging @nick since v2.2 had some tokenization/initialization changes.
nick: noted — there's a small init path that can prolong cold-starts for the python harness. will check if that correlates with these tests.
sam: can someone try a focused rerun of the failing tests with an increased timeout? command: ```./tools/ci/run_tests.sh bench-smoke --tests test_embedding_cache_expiry bench_end2end_controller:test_ping --timeout 90``` If that passes, likely infra/flake; if not, we should bisect the model bump.
jordan: kicked a narrow rerun now (job b-2026-1770000100). will post results when done.
infra-bot: rerun started (b-2026-1770000100) — runner: gpu-pool-07.
jordan: quick update — rerun passed for `test_embedding_cache_expiry` but `bench_end2end_controller:test_ping` still timed out. stack shows a `grpc connect timeout` inside the test harness during model init.
dev-qa: suggestion: add a short warmup call after model swap (10s) and temporarily increase the test timeout to 90s. next steps: 1) add warmup to cron, 2) bump test timeout, 3) if flake persists, bisect model commits between v2.1.2 and v2.2.0.
miriam: plan sounds good. @sam — can you open a quick PR to bump the timeout and add the warmup in the cron job? tag dev-qa for verification. I'll hold off on paging more folks or escalating to customers for now.
sam: will open PR in a few mins and link it here. assigning myself to bisect only if the PR doesn't stabilize the suite. :eyes:
nick: i'll follow up on the tokenization init perf with the model team, try to land a micro-fix if we can. :white_check_mark:
